title: Rollout SDK & Control-plane primitives for percent-based canaries, shadowing and experiment lifecycle
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Scope: Design and implement API endpoints and SDK client helpers for managing model rollouts (percent-based canaries), A/B experiments, shadow traffic copies, and automated rollback policies. Deliverables include a control-plane REST API, idempotent client primitives for safe retries, RBAC permission model, audit/event surfaces for Console and observability, and runtime hooks for execution and rollback.

Goals: 
- Provide a minimal public API that teams can use to declare rollouts and read status.
- Ensure SDK helpers make common flows (create canary, advance percentage, schedule ramp, cancel, rollback) ergonomic and idempotent.
- Support shadow traffic configuration (copy X% of traffic for observability without impacting production), and A/B experiment routing with metrics collection.
- Implement automatic rollback policy: evaluate metric windows and trigger rollback when regressions exceed configured thresholds.

Out of scope for this ticket: UI work in Console (separate PM tickets), deep experiment analysis pipelines (post-hoc analytics is a follow-up), and private-deployment packaging nuances (handled by Private team later).
acceptance_criteria: A1: REST endpoints exist for create_rollout, patch_rollout (partial update), get_rollout, list_rollouts, delete_rollout, and trigger_rollback and each returns stable resource IDs.
A2: SDK provides client helper methods mirroring endpoints with built-in idempotency using client-supplied idempotency_key and server-side dedup detection; repeated network retries must be safe.
A3: Rollout spec supports: traffic_split (%), routing_rules (by route tag), variant_model_id, start_time, schedule (timed ramp), and rollback_policy (metric name, window, direction, threshold).
A4: Shadow config supports copy_percentage, metadata redaction toggle, and distinct metric ingestion tag so shadowed requests do not affect production metrics by default.
A5: Automatic rollback triggers a documented state transition (ROLLED_BACK) with audit event and optional notification webhook; rollback is reversible via a manual resume API call.
A6: RBAC roles enforced: rollout_admin (full), rollout_operator (create/advance/cancel but not delete), rollout_viewer (read-only). Missing permissions return 403 with clear error code.
A7: End-to-end integration test covering: create canary 5% -> advance to 20% -> simulate metric regression -> automatic rollback occurs and status surfaces to API/SDK; logs and audit events emitted.
A8: Documentation draft (API schema, SDK examples, migration guide from current ad-hoc rollout scripts) published in GitHub docs folder and linked from PR description.
